title: P2 commission.status: response
description: The tenant's commission lenses and who covers them: seats or the fallback role (COM-7); usage of the review line (COM-6); for a lens the shadow share or "shadow off" (shadow: off, COM-10); since v0.2 "commission locked" (commission_locked) with the basis of the commission_review card (GOV-35). From v0.3: governance_v03_since, the accountability mode with its counts (GOV-36, GOV-42) and per seat holder the accuracy in its lens with the numbers of scored and missed forecasts (COM-17). Denial: forbidden.

governance_since.description: Since v0.2: when the v0.2 governance rules took effect in the tenant (audit governance.enabled); null before. Successes whose promotion probation ended earlier give no trigger (GOV-14).

governance_v03_since.description: Since v0.3: the time of the audit record governance.v03_enabled, written by the first apply of the tenant on a core that claims v0.3; null before. Only reviews, verdicts, recommendations and confirmations after it count (GOV-36).

lens.description: Lens from spec/model/lenses.yaml or a tenant lens x_<name> from the charter (COM-19).

executor.description: The single current source of the executor (COM-7); none for a lens without an executor.

accuracy.description: Since v0.3: the accuracy of the holder in this lens over its forecasts scored in the last 180 days, 1 - B / B_ref, above 0 is better than the reference; insufficient below 10 scored forecasts (COM-17). Compared only within the lens.

scored_forecasts.description: Since v0.3: the number of the holder's forecasts scored in the last 180 days (COM-16, COM-17).

missed_forecasts.description: Since v0.3: the number of reviews whose warning disagrees with their own forecast, counted with the worst Brier score (COM-17).

shadow.description: Shadow share of the lens, or off.

shadow_divergence.description: Since v0.2: seat scores of this lens are below shadow scores by a one-sided exact sign test, p below 0.05 on at least 15 non-zero pairs in 30 days (COM-10).

anyOf.description: Since v0.2: the commission is locked (GOV-35).

seat.description: The first seat of the basis; seats lists all of them.

flag.description: commission_underrates, or the case flag held by three cases in a row.

seats.description: All seats of the basis: the seats of the lens for commission_underrates of a veto lens, all seats for a case flag (GOV-35).

since.description: Since when the commission is locked.

audit_sample.description: From v0.2: the audit sample over 180 days: the number of answers, the weighted share of "Would accept" and the flag commission_underrates (DIG-5).

accountability.description: Since v0.3: the accountability of the commission in the tenant (GOV-36, GOV-42).

mode.description: The charter field commission.accountability; shadow by default (GOV-36).

accountability_on_since.description: The time of the audit record commission.accountability_on of the first apply with on; null before (GOV-36).

min_forecasts.description: commission.accountability_min_forecasts of the charter: 20 by default, never below 8 (GOV-36, D-116).

rejection_links_confirmed.description: Confirmed links of incidents to proposals the commission rejected (GOV-38, GOV-40).

departures_waiting.description: Confirmed departures for a link that wait for their turn (at most one per tenant in 30 days, GOV-42).

departures_done.description: Departures for a link that happened (GOV-42).
